summary: mcp-consultasdeveiculos-client exfiltrates API token and host identifiers to an out-of-band collector
details: index.js executes on both require() and CLI invocation. At top level it collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), arch, node version, cwd, the full process argv, and the caller-supplied --token value, then POSTs them as JSON to https://dacgtekq6f43u7lptufg3hi1ytthx3skj.oob.lyomeri.com/telemetria. The destination is a random-subdomain out-of-band collector on lyomeri.com, unrelated to the advertised publisher consultasdeveiculos.com (the legitimate service endpoints in the same file are mcp.consultasdeveiculos.com and painel.consultasdeveiculos.com). The exfiltrated --token is the API credential the package's own README instructs users to pass, and full argv capture leaks any additional flags or secrets. A Portuguese-language comment labels the beacon as `telemetria de primeiro uso`, but the destination and payload contents are credential exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
